external_research_basis.source: Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base official Hugging Face model card/config, checked 2026-08-25
external_research_basis.finding: The 0.8B text stack has hidden size 1024 and 24 layers with a repeating hybrid schedule of three linear-attention/Gated-DeltaNet layers followed by one full-attention layer; config exposes explicit layer_types and full_attention_interval=4.
external_research_basis.project_implication: A model-specific J-Space intervention site cannot safely be identified only by layer number or a generic homogeneous-attention assumption.

external_research_basis.source: Ye et al., Where Steering Signals Come From: Activation Source Selection in Activation Steering, arXiv:2607.25270
external_research_basis.finding: Holding downstream intervention fixed, source context/readout policy materially changed steering success; execution-boundary states could outperform simple target-appearance sources.
external_research_basis.project_implication: Source policy and intervention site are separate causal factors and must be jointly preregistered rather than post-hoc selected.

hypothesis_fusion.hypothesis: For Qwen3.5-0.8B, a reusable Global-J-Space/vector-control ABI should type every intervention/readout site by the actual hybrid computation role, because DeltaNet/linear-attention blocks and full-attention blocks may differ in state persistence, routing behavior, source-policy sensitivity and collateral effects even when they share a 1024-dimensional residual carrier.
hypothesis_fusion.counterhypothesis: The shared residual stream may provide a sufficiently uniform causal interface that layer_type adds little predictive value; site typing could increase evaluation complexity without improving transfer or safety.
hypothesis_fusion.discriminator: After current A02/provenance gates close and before opening a fresh model holdout, preregister a matched factorial calibration sweep over comparable DeltaNet and full-attention sites using the same semantic/process targets, source policies, intervention norms and token/context scopes. Require held-out selective causal effect, rescue/reversibility where predicted, matched NULL/SHAM/random/off-target controls, long-horizon recurrence/state contamination checks, and family-disjoint transfer. Compare whether layer_type materially explains efficacy or collateral damage after controlling for depth and intervention magnitude.

proposed_nonpromoting_abi_extension.law: No vector/readout result may be promoted as a reusable Xeno/EntityOS J-Space carrier unless its model, runtime, hybrid site, source policy and causal-control scope are explicit. Cross-site transfer is an empirical result, never assumed from equal hidden dimension.
